notes.title: Mac and Linux versions, buffs to Masashige & Oda, along with bugfixes!
notes.content:
The release of HAYAI has been [i]tremendous[/i]! Thank you all so much! It's much more than I could have hoped for.

Firstly, there are now [b]native Mac OS and Linux versions[/b]! I primarily work on Windows, but I will try to offer as much assistance as I can if there are any issues! (I've tested it on Linux and it works well, haven't tried Mac yet..)

If you want to sync up your stats across operating systems and Steam Cloud doesn't work for whatever reason, remember that you can sync your stats with Steam at any time from the options!

Also, Masashige and Oda turned out to have the lowest scores by a long shot, so I've buffed them slightly.

Masashige, in particular, should be more usable, which I'm a fan of, since he has one of my favourite playstyles!

Again, thanks for your support!

[b]Buffs[/b]
- Masashige now has a regular, faster charge rate (initially 75% regular charge rate)
- Oda now has a 0.25x combo multiplier instead of a 0.15x combo multiplier

[b]Bugfixes/Other[/b]
- Fixed issue that required manual FPS capping from Nvidia control panel
- Fixed lag during attack, especially for Hideyoshi
- Moved user/global leaderboard button to be more obvious
- Fixed a grammatical error with Oda's description
